programmes.t: On the Case: Footprints and Whispers
programmes.d: A beloved husband and wife are found dead in their own home. Will the killers own words bring him to justice?

programmes.t: On the Case: A Killer in Town
programmes.d: Paula Zahn examines how police raced to track down a vicious killer on his deadly cross-country journey.

programmes.t: On the Case: Terror in Bedford Park
programmes.d: A young woman is found stabbed to death locked inside a locker at a storage facility.

programmes.t: On the Case: Haunting Memories
programmes.d: Twenty-year-old college student Kim Montelaro goes missing from a mall parking lot, then her lifeless body is found in a ravine five miles from the mall; investigators piece together the timeline of Montelaro's last moments alive and crack the case.

programmes.t: On the Case: One of Their Own
programmes.d: The daughter of an FBI agent is abducted from the Tucson airport, where she had gone to pick up her husband. Months later, her body is found in a shallow grave, sparking what would become one of the FBI's longest homicide investigations.

programmes.t: On the Case: Spreadsheet of Terror
programmes.d: When the body of a teenage girl is found in the Columbia River, police wonder if she was the victim of an accident or suicide. But the evidence reveals it was the beginning of disturbing murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: Driven to Murder
programmes.d: A woman is at first thought to be the victim a deadly hit-and-run, until police find the car that killed her nearby, and it turns out to be her own.

programmes.t: On the Case: Stacy's Story
programmes.d: July 30th, 1980. Judy Linzey returned home in Oxnard, California. As she unlocked the front door, she noticed drops of blood on her porch and hurried inside and called out to her teenage daughter but there was no answer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Deception
programmes.d: Officers investigate the death of a father of four who was gunned down, however nothing about the crime is what it appears to be.

programmes.t: On the Case: Blood, Sweat and Tears
programmes.d: A cold case team reopens the investigation into the murder of 36-year-old Linda Robinson who is savagely murdered while her seven-year-old niece is asleep in the next room.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Secret Meeting
programmes.d: After a teenager mysteriously disappears, police must determine if a secret meeting with a young man led to her murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Murder in Thunderbolt
programmes.d: When a couple is shot down in front of their home in the quiet suburb of Thunderbolt, Georgia, the entire community hears the barrage of gunfire. As police sift through the evidence, they must determine if one of the neighbors is a witness or the killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Murder in Room 205
programmes.d: A young woman's journey to a new life comes to a savage end in a roadside motel.

programmes.t: On the Case: Kidnapped on the 4th of July
programmes.d: When a young woman's pizza delivery car is found abandoned in the middle of the desolate stretch of road, a twenty three year mystery begins.

programmes.t: On the Case: Cali-Doe
programmes.d: A young girl is murdered in Caledonia New York, and police struggle to identify her. The tragedy leads the town make her one of their own, with the name Cali-Doe.

programmes.t: On the Case: Driven to Kill
programmes.d: A new father comes home to find his infant son and wife missing. Four months later their bodies are found in a remote wooded area. When police investigate the father's past they find the reason for the unthinkable crime.

programmes.t: On the Case: Deadly Paper Trail
programmes.d: The police follow a trail of emails, hoping it will lead them to a 38-year-old woman's vicious killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Left in the Dark
programmes.d: When a beautiful young graduate student is found stabbed to death, detectives must determine if the murder was a crime of passion or a brutal attack by a violent intruder.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Slip of Fate
programmes.d: A woman is found clinging to the guardrail of a steep embankment. She tells police a harrowing story; two men had attacked her and her husband at gunpoint and now he is missing. Was it a robbery gone wrong or part of a far more sinister plot?

programmes.t: On the Case: Devil in a Cowboy Hat
programmes.d: A young woman is found bound and strangled to death on the side of a road. As police retrace her final steps, they discover she was last seen being followed by a suspicious man in a cowboy hat.

programmes.t: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programmes.d: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Twisted Lies
programmes.d: In Las Vegas, 41-year-old Nancy Menke, a mother of four, is found handcuffed and murdered in the passenger seat of her car; a records clerk in the insurance fraud unit stumbles upon a strange report that blows open Menke's murder case.

programmes.t: On the Case: In the Blink of an Eye
programmes.d: November 21, 1988, Sheriff's deputies received an alarming phone call from a convenience store in Leesville, Louisiana. A delivery person said the clerk who signs for deliveries was missing and the store's cash register was open and empty

programmes.t: On the Case: Unthinkable Harm
programmes.d: When a teenager is found savagely stabbed to death in her home, police hope a trail of blood found at the crime scene will lead them to her killer.

programmes.t: On the Case: Last Dance
programmes.d: A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

programmes.t: On the Case: Long Sought Truth
programmes.d: Sunday December 3rd, 1978. A motorist walked into the empty office of a Palmdale, California gas station and stumbled upon the aftermath of a violent robbery. Even more chilling was the fact that station's attendant was nowhere to be found.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Different Time
programmes.d: When Barbara Rowan left her house on an afternoon in 1984, she had a baseball mitt, a ball and a radio. Barbara claimed she was on her way to meet her coach. After she didn't return home, Police discovered that the teenager didn't play any sports.

programmes.t: On the Case: A Murder in Coralville
programmes.d: October 21st, 1981 22-year-old Vicki Klotzbach was reported missing. The research lab employee failed to show up for work and no one had seen or heard from Vicki in more than 24 hours
